default.description: Capabilities for the main window. The window loads the LIVE site (remote origin), so this capability must (a) include that origin under `remote.urls` and (b) explicitly grant the app commands — their allow-* permissions are generated by build.rs (AppManifest.commands). `local: true` keeps dev (`tauri dev` against the Vite server) working. core defaults let the frontend listen for the capture-hotkey event.
